provenance.basis: retained Unity C# field declarations and recovered ISIL from the v1.3.18 checkpoint
provenance.status: source behavior proven; authored scene values exported in animation_manifest.json

on_enter_inner.one_shot_guard: If _isTriggered is already true, return. Otherwise set it true before starting the action.
on_enter_inner.rotation_semantics: DOTween rotation tween toward the serialized Euler endpoint; integer mode 0 is passed as the final overload argument. Scene instance values for six level4 actions are in animation_manifest.json.
on_enter_inner.sound_call: Select one element randomly from serialized _sounds, then raise the common sound event with ESoundSource value 3.
on_enter_inner.sound_limit: The trigger stores ESound enum entries, not AudioClip pointers. A WAV named House_Doors_Open_* alone does not prove it is the selected sound.

remaining_limits: The retained level1 main-house scene has no TriggerObjectOpenDoor instance; its six room doors use DoorTrigger instead.
The runtime ESound-to-AudioClip route is not included in this animation manifest.
required_static_inputs: NoImNotAHuman_Data/globalgamemanagers (for external script/type metadata when needed)
matching sharedassets0 resource companion files only if referenced streamed media bytes are to be verified

runtime_rules.start_rotation: Awake captures Transform.rotation, converts quaternion to positive world Euler degrees, and stores as _startRotation.

normal_open.name_mapping_status: mapped from standard DOTween Ease enumeration; enum declaration not retained locally

normal_close.name_mapping_status: mapped from standard DOTween Ease enumeration; enum declaration not retained locally

ease_values.source_call_target: 0x180AA6520 follows DORotate and receives the numeric Ease value; retained disassembly has no method name.

runtime_rules.await: Room extra-action coroutine awaits the rotation tween. The exact inherited base-view dispatch point relative to a host scene transition is unresolved.

room_door_trigger.scene_instances: Six room-linked instances and their pivot, world transform, renderer, room-action raycast target, and collider IDs are in animation_manifest.json.

frame_timing.behavior_note: AnimatedImage sets the first frame for Cycle on StartAnimationOrSetFirstFrame; other types start the playback coroutine. Runtime elapsed time and Unity scheduling are not reproduced by this source manifest.

scene_inventory.limit: Aggregate counts establish authored scene animation components, not that all characters animate or which one is visible in an initial gameplay state.

character_data.limit: A real NPC playback choice requires its exact AnimationData frames/FPS/cycling type and runtime-selected emotion. No character is asserted as the initial live actor from these aggregates.

implementation_boundary.door: Use extracted scene transform and serialized angle/duration when available. If the runtime interpolates only the hinge transform with a generic easing approximation, label it as a host approximation and preserve source duration/endpoint separately.
implementation_boundary.character: Use the exact source frame order and FPS from the emotion registry. If frame scheduling is adapted to Android elapsed time, label the scheduler adaptation; do not claim Unity coroutine timing identity.
